body:
GitHub https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/1493

## Summary
The corpus MCP records nothing about how it answers over time. A team replacing another documentation server needs per-tool outcome counters (answered, no-match, capability-absent, refused, error) and latency, to set and gate an answer-rate floor, without storing request text. #1480 covers an offline labelled evaluation; this is the runtime counterpart.

## Environment
- Build: main-ef2a01d. Per-call `_meta["corvint/timing"]` exists; no aggregation.

## Expected
- Opt-in flag (e.g. `--outcome-log FILE`) writing aggregate counters only: tool, outcome/miss kind, count, latency histogram, corpus identity, time window. Never arguments, query text, ids or paths.
- A CLI to summarise the file and compare against a stored floor (exit non-zero on regression).

## Acceptance tests
- After N calls the file holds per-tool counts that sum to N and contains no request string (test greps for each query string).
- Disabled by default; enabling it does not change any receipt.
- Floor comparison fails when the answered share drops below floor minus tolerance.
